sketches.mechanism: An object can be resurrected during finalization by saving `self` in `__del__`, creating a new strong reference while it is being destroyed.
sketches.resonance: The farewell itself becomes the hand that keeps the departed present.
sketches.draft:
last = None
class ghost:
    def __del__(self):
        global last
        last = self

g = ghost()
del g

sketches.mechanism: Lazy evaluation permits a self-referential bottom value to exist harmlessly until it is demanded.
sketches.resonance: What cannot be faced may remain in the world as long as no one asks it to answer.

sketches.mechanism: `Nothing` is the bottom type, so an expression that never returns can be used wherever any other type is expected.
sketches.resonance: A refusal to arrive can satisfy every promised shape because it never has to become one.
sketches.draft:
fun never(): Nothing = throw Throwable()

val morning: Int = never()
val letter: Char = never()
